title: Seaside Studio Retreat with Outdoor Living & Beach Access Sleeps 2
meta_description: Seaside studio for 2 with a king bed, private outdoor living spaces, outdoor shower, and a short walk to the beach, pools, and tennis courts.
description_expanded: Bingo’s Bungalow | Intimate Seaside Guest Studio RetreatThe name says it all—Bingo’s Bungalow is a cozy, beautifully designed hideaway in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Serving as the guest studio to “For My Girls,” this charming bungalow offers a peaceful escape where tropical vibes meet forest serenity, highlighted by its vivid green exterior and lush surrounding greenery.Charming Interiors Made for TwoStep inside to a bright, fresh white interior accented with classic Seaside details. Thoughtfully laid out for comfort, the space offers more than enough room for couples to settle in and truly unwind. A sweet, well-equipped kitchenette makes it easy to prepare a homemade breakfast or enjoy treats from a nearby bakery. The inviting king bed anchors the space, with the bathroom just steps away for added convenience.Two Private Outdoor RetreatsOne of the bungalow’s most delightful features is its two private outdoor living spaces, perfect for soaking in Seaside’s beautiful weather. The back porch provides a tranquil setting for morning coffee as the sun rises, while the upper-level porch offers a romantic perch for intimate conversations and evening wine beneath the stars.Perfect Couple’s Getaway in Seaside, FloridaDesigned with romance and relaxation in mind, Bingo’s Bungalow is an ideal retreat for couples seeking the full Seaside experience—warm hospitality, charming design, and unforgettable moments. For guests traveling with friends or family, the main house “For My Girls” may also be rented, offering additional space while keeping everyone close.Whether it’s a weekend escape or a special celebration, Bingo’s Bungalow invites you to slow down, reconnect, and create lasting memories in Seaside, Florida.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES384 square feetAccess to Seaside’s private residential beach at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside features the largest private residential beaches on 30AApproximately 167 yards (3-minute walk) to beach accessPole-mounted grillPeacock Alley linens featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayStarter amenities providedParking: One parking pass issued per one-bedroom home (a golf cart is considered a vehicle)Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed STR23-001918
